acceptance.availability: At least 99.5% expected qualified closes durably available within 300s; every missing/late period produces explicit non-actionable state. Percentage never permits acting on a bad bar.
acceptance.benchmark: Predeclared seed/workload/hardware/storage, repeated low-rate/coincident-close/backfill/slow-disk/contention/crash runs; report p50/p95/p99/max, counts, loss, duplicates and CPU/disk
acceptance.close_to_decision: <= 300s after completed native close with explicit causal availability; processing SLA is not a human response deadline
acceptance.correctness: Zero fabricated bars, unresolved duplicate decisions, symbol/interval/unit mismatches or silently filled gaps; verify native completed flags and OHLCV against independently auditable source receipts
acceptance.durability: Every admitted receipt charged/committed exactly once; decision, prefix, watermark and snapshot transactionally bound; crash at each commit boundary cannot lose/duplicate admissions
acceptance.receipt_to_durable: p99 <= 2s, max <= 10s on declared hardware/filesystem with counts/repeats and injected stalls
acceptance.recovery: <= 300s after source return, subject to complete prefix, integrity and backfill caps; no signals from unresolved catch-up
acceptance.safety: Queue exhaustion, disk/quota failure, wall discontinuity, bad TLS, denial, integrity mismatch or stale/missing period hard-stop/withhold new review states

high_rate_exclusion_proof: allowlisted active src has no PublicTransport/PublicEngine/selector/bridge acquisition modules
quant entrypoint exposes offline swing commands only
frozen source guard references outside import path
historical_M1B: PARTIAL_MULTIPLE remains; sustained150/s and checkpoint failures not reclassified
independent_live_dependencies: reviewed correct official endpoints and units
native source evidence within permitted windows
no reuse or extension of old grants
measurement_window: At least seven calendar days of independently audited qualified native close events per symbol/timeframe; maintenance and denial remain in the declared denominator
supersedes_only: NEW swing release acceptance when old sustained BBO/high-rate components are outside the active critical path
synthetic_microbenchmark: audit/low_rate_microbenchmark_final.json; engineering contract/store timing only, bound to final code hashes

workload.if_BBO_retained: Original 128 queue, sticky 50ms wall stop, durable per-frame accounting and TLS stay binding; low-rate bars do not waive its source-specific acceptance
workload.normal_arrivals: 3 completed 1H bars/hour, plus 3 completed 4H bars/4h and 3 completed 1D bars/day
